newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MANCINI SAYS HE LEAVING SAMPDORIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCINI SAYS HE LEAVING SAMPDORIA.

text.p: Sampdoria striker Roberto Mancini announced on Friday that he would play his last game for the Genoa club at the weekend.
The 32-year-old former Italy international has scored more goals in his career than any other player active in serie A and has been a stalwart at Sampdoria for 15 seasons.
Mancini did not say where he would be playing next season although expectations are that it will be Lazio.
"I have still not signed any contract," he told a news conference at a hotel near Genoa where Sampdoria regularly gather before their league matches.
The departure of Mancini, who with Gianluca Vialli made up the "terrible twins" that helped Sampdoria win their first ever league title in 1990-91, had been widely expected.

Sampdoria have already signed German captain Juergen Klinsmann for next season while coach Sven-Goran Eriksson, with whom Mancini has a good relationship, is due to take over at Lazio and has been expected to take Mancini with him.
Sampdoria, who have already clinched a UEFA Cup place next season, play Fiorentina in their final match.
